properties.title: Manage your fieldwork directly from your app with QFieldCloud API integration
properties.description:
Get familiar with the latest QFieldCloud development, QFieldCloud RESTful API and the QFieldCloud SDK.

QField helps people map and understand the world, QFieldCloud helps people automate their data collection and fieldwork.

If your organization already has an application that manages processes and workflows, or you simply want to run a nightly cron to automate processing on your data, the QFieldCloud RESTful API will help you do that.

We will look at some of the newest QFieldCloud features and how we can access them via QFieldCloud CLI, QFieldCloud SDK or simply by running a HTTP request against QFieldCloud API endpoint.
